title: install-prober: Terraform install compatibility auditor for quotas, IAM, DNS and GPU capacity
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Build an ‘install-prober’ tool that runs a deterministic set of Terraform-compatible checks before a Private (VPC) install. The prober will be used by Solutions Engineering during customer onboarding and by the automated VPC installer pipeline to fail fast and provide actionable remediation steps. It must integrate with our Terraform modules, consume a plan/state, and be safe to run repeatedly (idempotent read-only checks).

Core responsibilities:
- Validate cloud quotas and soft limits (vCPU, GPUs by type, ENIs, public IPs, SSD IOPS for boot disks) for target account/region/AZ.
- Verify IAM roles/policies expected by the Terraform modules: assume-role permissions, service principal trust for our installer service account, KMS key policies for state encryption and runtime key access.
- Confirm DNS setup: delegation to private hosted zone, Route53 inbound endpoints (or equivalent), forwarding rules, and ability to create internal CNAMEs and SRV records.
- Check GPU availability and instance quota per AZ for requested GPU SKU families; detect insufficient contiguous node pool quotas that would block autoscaling.
- Validate Terraform backend access (S3/GCS), lock table permissions (DynamoDB/Cloud SQL), and KMS/HSM IAM bindings.
- Provide a machine-readable report and an easy-to-read remediation guide with targeted Terraform snippets or cloud console links.

Non-goals: the prober will not modify infra or apply Terraform plans. It will not attempt to provision resources as health checks (no test VMs), and it will not perform deep application-level e2e tests (those live in post-install smoke-suite).
acceptance_criteria: A read-only CLI 'install-prober' that accepts: a target cloud provider, region, path to terraform plan or state, and credentials (env-based).
Quota checks return per-limit status with current usage, requested headroom, and suggested quota requests (console links + one-line terraform alternatives where applicable).
IAM check enumerates required roles/policies and flags missing inline or policy differences with minimal-diff output and remediation snippets for Terraform IAM module.

DNS check verifies target hosted zone delegation and ability to create internal records; if not delegated, returns step-by-step delegation instructions including example aws_route53_record and terraform route53-zone config.
GPU capacity check evaluates SKU-level quota and region/AZ fragmentation, and flags when requested nodepool sizes cannot be satisfied across AZs.
Outputs two artifacts: a human-readable markdown report and a JSON report conforming to our 'installer-probe-v1' schema.
Automated unit tests covering quota parsing logic for AWS and GCP mock APIs and an integration run against staging account.

comments: 2025-02-10 Asha Patel: Initial ticket created after failed install for ACME Corp where ENI and GPU quotas were the root causes. Captured first-pass checklist from SE postmortem.
2025-02-11 Diego Moreno: Scoped deliverables for Cycle 2025-W07. Suggested JSON report schema fields and CLI UX; prefer exit codes that map to severity (0=ok, 1=warning, 2=fail).

2025-02-12 Priya Shah: Prototype quota fetchers for AWS EC2 DescribeAccountAttributes and GCP compute.projects.get returned. Need service account with viewer+quota API roles for reliable reads. Added notes on eventual paginated quotas.

2025-02-13 Koji Tanaka: DNS checks prototype found edge case: on-prem DNS resolvers behind private endpoints require conditional forwarders; added a 'resolver test' step that will attempt SRV/CNAME record creation in the hosted zone via API (read-only until dry-run disabled).

2025-02-14 Diego Moreno: Added IAM diffing approach: pull expected IAM JSON from terraform modules/iam/roles.json and compare against cloud returned policy using policy-normalized canonicalization to reduce noise from ordering. Need to coordinate with infra-as-code to keep roles.json synced.

2025-02-15 Priya Shah: Implemented GPU fragmentation check algorithm and ran against staging region us-west-2; found fragmentation warning for p4d where individual AZ quotas are under requested nodepool sizes. Added remediation: reduce per-AZ replica target or request quota increases with exact API calls/console links.
